seo.title: ReportAI — Dictate the visit, sign the report
seo.description: Dictate the site visit on your phone and ReportAI fills in the report in your company's own Word template: each hazard with its contractor, action and deadline. You review it and sign it off. Try it with your voice.

cta.note: Not for sale yet: email me and we'll try it with your team.

hero.sub: Say what you see on site and ReportAI writes it into your company's own Word template: each hazard with the contractor, the action and the deadline. If something required is missing, it asks. You review it and sign it off.

said.deficiency: On the third floor the north edge guardrail is missing.
said.action: Levante Structures to fit it before anyone works in that area again.”

values.deficiency: North edge guardrail missing on the third floor
values.deadline: Before work resumes in the area

offline.title: Records with no signal
offline.body: It sends itself once you're back in coverage.

review.title: Nothing goes out unreviewed
review.body: Every report is approved before it's sent.

night.heading: The report gets written at night.
night.body: The visit takes an hour. The report takes another: typing up the notebook and the photos at home, long after the site has emptied. And the report the client expected today arrives tomorrow.
night.turn: ReportAI swaps the order: the report is written while you talk, on site, and all that's left for the evening is signing it. Or not even that.

steps.heading: Three steps. The last one is yours.

dictate.title: Dictate on site
dictate.body: Open the app on your phone and talk through the visit the way you'd tell a colleague. Add photos if you like. With no signal, the recording waits on the phone and sends itself once you're back in coverage.

review.title: Check what it understood
review.body: In under a minute you have the draft with every field filled in and, next to each one, the sentence it came from. Anything missing is flagged for you to fill in, by voice or by typing.

sign.title: Approve and send
sign.body: Approving it builds the PDF in your template and emails it to whoever you've set up. Who approved it, and when, is on record.

demo.heading: Try it with your voice.
demo.sub: Describe a short visit, about thirty seconds: where you are, what you've seen, who needs to fix it and by when. You'll watch the report fill in with what you say.
demo.hint: For example: “12 High Street site. The scaffold on the front elevation has no debris netting. Soler Scaffolding to fit it today before five.”

states.failed: We couldn't process this one. Try again with a bit more detail.
states.perIp: You've used today's tries. Three more tomorrow, or email me and try it with your team.
states.full: The live demo is full for today. Come back tomorrow, or email me and try it with your team.
states.unavailable: The live demo isn't available right now. Listen to the sample visit instead.
states.noMic: This browser can't use the microphone. Type the visit instead.
states.denied: No microphone permission. You can type the visit instead.

demo.pdf: Open the report as a PDF
demo.privacy: The recording is transcribed by Groq, interpreted by Anthropic's Claude and deleted after 24 hours. Please don't include real people's details. {policy}
demo.sample: No microphone to hand? Listen to a real sample visit

template.heading: Your Word file, not ours.
template.body: Upload the template you already use, logo and layout included. An assistant suggests which fields it has and where each one goes; you correct them and test it before going live. Your clients get the same document as always.
template.starters: No template? Start with one of ours: health and safety visit, site visit report, work order or incident report.

review.heading: The AI doesn't sign for you.

evidence.title: Every detail, with its sentence.
evidence.body: Next to each field you see the part of the recording that supports it. Whatever wasn't said stays blank: nothing is filled in on a hunch.

missing.title: What's missing gets asked for.
missing.body: If your template marks a detail as required (the date, who made the visit) and you didn't say it, it asks for it. In the app, the report can't be approved until you add it. Whatever wasn't said stays blank, in plain sight.

approval.title: You decide when it goes.
approval.body: No report is sent until someone with permission approves it. Who and when is on record.

review.quote: “…Levante Structures to fit it before anyone works in that area again.”

savings.heading: What it gives back, in hours.
savings.sub: Plug in your team's numbers. The starting values are assumptions, not measurements: use your own.
savings.result: hours a month no longer spent writing reports
savings.assumption: Starting assumption: 3 technicians, 6 reports a week each and 35 minutes per report, against 8 reviewing.

built.heading: What's behind the report.
built.lead: I designed and built ReportAI, from the recording to the PDF. This is what happens between you speaking and the report reaching its recipient; every decision, with its reasons, is in the case study.

capture.title: Capture
capture.body: The field app records with no signal and uploads the note once coverage is back.

transcribe.title: Transcription
transcribe.body: The voice becomes text in a few seconds.

agent.title: Agent
agent.body: A LangGraph graph of 25 nodes takes each detail with the sentence it came from, asks for what's missing and stops until someone approves it.

document.title: Document
document.body: It fills in your Word template and turns it into a PDF.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: It emails the report and records who approved it, and when.

tenancy.title: One company never sees another
tenancy.body: 29 routes with an id, requested by another company's admin: all 29 answer 404.

eval.title: Measured, not assumed
eval.body: 83 test visits over 3 runs: 99.8%, 100% and 99.7% of fields right, with not a single invented detail.

install.title: Hosted or on your server
install.body: The same code. On your server it installs with one command.

who.label: Who built it
who.body: I design it, write it and run it. The code is public: you can check how it's built.

invent.a: It can mishear a sentence, like anyone taking quick notes. That's why every field shows the sentence it came from, whatever wasn't said stays blank, and no report goes out until you approve it.

data.a: On a server in the European Union. Groq and Anthropic transcribe and interpret the visit, under a data processing agreement. Recordings are deleted after 90 days, and you can export or delete all of your company's data from the dashboard.

template.q: Will it work with my template?
template.a: If it's a Word file (.docx), yes. Upload yours and an assistant marks where each detail goes; you check it and run a test before using it with clients.

offline.q: What if there's no signal on site?
offline.a: The app keeps the recording on the phone and sends it once the signal is back. If you've signed in on that phone before, it opens even offline.

install.a: No. It's a web app you add to your home screen like any other app. Technicians sign in with a link sent by email, no passwords. You can also send the visit over Telegram or by email.

book.q: Does it replace the site incident book?
book.a: No. ReportAI writes the visit report. The incident book, the construction phase plan and contractor coordination follow their own process.

responsibility.q: Who is responsible for what the report says?
responsibility.a: Whoever approves it, as with any report. ReportAI prepares the draft; the technical judgement and the signature are yours.

selfhost.q: Can we run it on our own server?
selfhost.a: Yes. It installs on your server with one command and a setup wizard, uses your own AI provider account, and data only leaves your infrastructure to reach that provider.

sale.a: Not yet: ReportAI is a project in development and isn't for sale. If you'd like to try it with your team, email me and we'll set it up, with sample data in a trial account or installed on your server.

closing.heading: Your next visit, with the report done before you're back at the car.
closing.sub: I'll set it up with your own template.

footer.tagline: From dictation on site to a report in your template.
